action_type.description: Type of action (click, navigate, type, etc.)

target_element.description: CSS selector or description of target

description.description: Human readable description of the step

screenshot_url.description: URL of screenshot when step was created

success.description: Whether the step was executed successfully

page_type.description: Type of page (homepage, project, editor, etc.)

content_summary.description: Summary of page content in text mode

element_type.description: Type of element (button, link, form, etc.)

action_context.description: When/how this element should be used

success_rate.description: Success rate of interactions with this pattern

database.instructions: This database stores AI learning data for WebSim tutorial generation. The AI analyzes screenshots and page content to build understanding of the WebSim interface. Tutorial steps track the learning process, while ui_patterns stores reusable interaction patterns discovered by the AI.
